id.description: Unique customer profile identifier, e.g., CUST-001

segment.description: Descriptive name for the customer segment

role.description: Typical job title or user persona

jobs_to_be_done.description: Primary functional, emotional, and social jobs the customer is trying to get done

acute_pains.description: Specific high-friction pain points, bottlenecks, or costs

current_workarounds.description: Hacks, spreadsheets, manual steps, or imperfect combinations used today

existing_solutions_used.description: Incumbent software, services, or resources currently used and their drawbacks

willingness_to_pay_signals.description: Observed evidence of commercial intent, budget authority, or alternative spending

communication_channels.description: Where this audience gathers, learns, and evaluates solutions

evidence_source_ids.description: Source IDs in sources.csv supporting this profile
